title: Complete a verified client enrollment request
description: A verified client can submit an enrollment request with the required details and receive an order reference.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the sign-in form
Open the enrollment section
Fill in the full name field with a valid name
Fill in the phone number field with a valid phone number
Fill in the specialization field with a valid specialization
Submit the enrollment request
Verify an order reference is displayed
Verify the enrollment request is recorded as submitted

title: Register a new client account
description: A prospective client can submit registration details and receive a verification prompt.

steps.description: Navigate to /register
Fill in the full name field with a valid name
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Provide the required consent
Submit the registration form
Verify a verification prompt is visible

title: Sign in and return to the requested destination
description: A client who signs in after being redirected can return to the originally requested page.

steps.description: Navigate to /admin/orders
Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the sign-in form
Verify the requested destination or account area is shown after sign in

title: Switch the homepage language and layout direction

steps.description: Navigate to /
Change the display language to Arabic
Verify the page content is shown in Arabic
Verify the text direction changes to right-to-left

title: Switch homepage language and text direction
description: A visitor can switch the homepage language and the page updates to the selected reading direction.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Select Arabic as the language
Verify the homepage content updates to Arabic and uses right-to-left direction
Select English as the language
Verify the homepage content updates to English and uses left-to-right direction

title: Verify a client email with a code

steps.description: Navigate to /verify-email
Enter a valid six-digit verification code
Submit the verification code
Verify a verified access confirmation is visible

Jump to the universities section
Jump to the enrollment section

Verify the navigation menu is closed
